title: D15 Brentwood - Cellular DE for Cooling Towers - Brentwood
description: The Brentwood Cellular D15 for cooling towers combine high drift elimination and low pressure drop. Call us to learn about additional DE's we offer!

layout.title: D15 Brentwood - Cellular DE for Cooling Towers - Brentwood

paragraphs: The D15 Cellular Drift Eliminator combines high drift elimination with low pressure drop, yielding an extremely efficient drift eliminator panel. Pack stiffness can be varied with the addition of a number of flat, 30-mil stiffener sheets that are bonded to the corrugated sheets. The side sheets of standard packs are flat to facilitate caulking, where necessary.
